added_failures_note: Derived by annotate_review_of_run from the reviewed run own baseline_suite and after_suite logs: both complete with zero FAILED ids, so added_failure_count=0 and added_failure_ids=[]. The baseline directory contained only test_traced_section_moments.py; its existing test also passes in staged-full-cpu.log. This zero does not validate cold timing.

assertion_audit.arithmetic_and_eager_guards: Host helper comparisons and five complete-kind gradient samples compare to pinned independent implementations; changing order or indiscriminately JITing eager differentiation can redden them.
assertion_audit.cold_compile_guard: Invalid: cached executable lookup can pass elapsed<30. Probe reproduces config=False with is_cache_used=True after the exact clear_caches/config sequence; resetting persistent cache state changes is_cache_used to False.
assertion_audit.expression_guard: Restoring baseline helpers gives 78404 equations, exceeding 20000; reproduction.log records before=after=78404 and its original tenfold guard fails. The independent baseline sanity guard requires >50000.
assertion_audit.identity_guards: Pinned git-show modules are rebound to separately loaded reference dependencies; finite checks and seven-component relative maxima fail on arithmetic drift. Historical packed candidate maximum 0.00010467739094605777 proves the identity instrument can discriminate.
assertion_audit.recurrence_guard: staged-negative.log deliberately drops one recurrence output, maximum=1, one failing identity test, EXIT=1; unmodified recurrence maximum=0.
assertion_audit.sharing_guard: Removing helper JIT staging eliminates the jit primitive from square make_jaxpr; square gradient has independent mathematical expected value 4.
assertion_audit.tenfold_guard: Strict xfail preserves the unmet tenfold target as executable evidence; reaching it causes XPASS and requires updating the record.

findings.text: blocking: _compile disables jax_enable_compilation_cache only after point and geometry setup has initialized cache use, and jax.clear_caches does not reset that memoized state in the installed JAX; h200-fresh-cold.log records exactly two jit_jet cache hits with stored compile costs 86 and 81 seconds while reporting 11.2194146 and 7.91631825 seconds as cold, so the under-30-second gate and the fragment's cold headline are invalid; disable persistent caching before any JAX work in a fresh process, require a receipt proving no executable cache hit, rerun both arms, and correct the evidence before landing.

follow-on: The actual topology-read cold compile, host RSS and executable-size clauses remain unmeasured; the fragment correctly carries them forward, and the reduced unique graph (17544) must not stand in for that gate because expanded equations increase from 83240 to 96854.

item_verdicts.diff: Read the base-to-head changes and 15-commit progression; rangefunction.py shares staged helper graphs, elliptic.py retains serial recurrence ordering, and the final two commits only adjust tests and evidence.
item_verdicts.done_when: The authorized resume-2-advice.txt accepts the 4.47-times graph reduction and strict tenfold xfail; h200-landing-gate.log records 8 passed and 1 xfailed, but h200-fresh-cold.log records persistent-cache hits for both measured point jets.
item_verdicts.goal: Read prompt.txt and both resume advice files; shared serial graphs preserve arithmetic and meet the revised 20000-equation target, but tests/biot/test_kernel_compile_cost.py:200 does not establish the retained cold-compile target.
item_verdicts.manifest: Read manifest.md, baseline_suite and after_suite logs; baseline has 1 passed, head has 8 passed and 1 xfailed, yielding zero added failing ids, while the claimed 7.9-second cold compile is contradicted by its cache receipt.
item_verdicts.write_paths: The 33-path final diff stays within the original grant plus the four sibling modules explicitly authorized in resume-1-advice.txt; no production caller was changed.

justifications.durability: tests/biot/test_kernel_compile_cost.py:181 and :360 catch graph growth and recurrence truncation, but its cold-compile assertion can pass by deserializing an existing executable.
justifications.evidence: The committed identity and recurrence logs support exact arithmetic, but docs/evidence/fragments/converged-forward-solve/cfs-kernel-compile-cost.html:20 labels cached compilation as cold despite the two jet cache hits in h200-fresh-cold.log.
justifications.fit: nova/biot/rangefunction.py:94 retains eager arithmetic and the public signatures, although staged detection relies on tracer attributes and a shared helper's fixed list of static parameter names.
justifications.goal_fidelity: nova/biot/rangefunction.py:106 achieves the coordinator-authorized sharing result, but tests/biot/test_kernel_compile_cost.py:200 leaves cold compilation under 30 seconds unproved.
justifications.reuse: The search of nova/biot and nova/jax found no existing staging-sensitive sharing owner; the added recurrence helpers extend elliptic.py, _pole_contraction is moved from Channel._pole rather than copied, and paired arithmetic remains owned by pairedfloat.py.
justifications.scope_discipline: All changed production paths are the six kernel modules named by the prompt and resume-1-advice.txt, with only the assigned test and evidence paths alongside them.

limitations: No full suite or H200 job rerun by this read-only review. Numerical receipts were read from the reviewed run.

The independent probe tests installed JAX cache-state behavior without compiling kernels or mutating repository source. It confirms the mechanism already visible in the fresh-process H200 cache receipt.
Stored cached_compile_seconds are historical cache metadata, not a newly measured cold compile; no new cold wall is claimed.
The 2912-byte value is generated_code_size_in_bytes, not serialized executable size.
